The name Subir carries the meaning “Early Dawn” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Subir usually hope their child will grow to embody early dawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
